note: B13 synthetic fixture utility lane, not a campaign result. Each task draws rows of width 64 with a target tone at the listed normalized frequency (amplitude 0.5..2, random phase), nuisance tones at the listed frequencies (amplitude 0..1.5, random phase) and uniform noise of +-0.1, all from Pcg32(seed, 0x676f65727a656c). The label is the target amplitude squared. Both arms fit the same ridge head (lambda_frac 0.02) on the same 96 training rows and are scored on the same 64 held-out rows: the reference reads the existing integer-bin DFT magnitude stage (fft_mag, all 32 bins), the candidate a one-bin goertzel_bank at the target frequency. Real-campaign W17 G-A..G-E and Baseline promotion remain held.
